facts.business: Aditya Infotech Limited is a leading Indian manufacturer of surveillance and electronic security solutions under the CP PLUS brand, offering CCTV cameras (IP and analog), video recorders (DVRs/NVRs), and related surveillance software.
key_risks: Revenue recognition risk due to large number of customers with varying commercial terms
Impairment risk of investment in and loans to subsidiary company
Dependence on STQC certification mandate for market advantage
Transition risk from analog to IP camera technology
Cybersecurity and data privacy risks in surveillance products
